read_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file. Existing workspace paths take precedence; missing relative paths fall back to a unique readable file in assigned skill roots. Use skill to select an assigned skill explicitly.

path.description: Workspace-first file path, or a relative path inside the explicitly selected skill.

skill.description: Optional assigned skill name. Resolves path only inside that skill; path must be relative and remain inside its root.

write_file.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file relative to the working directory.

bash.description: Run a shell command in the working directory.

activate_skill.description: Load the full instructions for an allowed skill.

list_available_tools.description: List installed native and artifact tool names, descriptions, and session access without executing or granting access. Access states do not guarantee policy approval.

request_tool.description: Request a tool be added to this subagent for the current session.

reason.description: Why the task needs this tool.

tool_authoring.description: Create and activate a user-owned tool artifact. ALL creation starts with only name, before generating a definition or files. The harness checks installed tools and requests preparation consent for missing tools. Only after preparation_authorized submit the full proposal for separate installation approval. For an invalid existing artifact, first send only name and replace_invalid=true; archive/recreation consent authorizes replacement preparation. A full proposal cannot bypass either gate. The harness requests consent; do not ask for conversational approval.

name.description: Artifact name: starts with a lowercase letter, followed by lowercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. Windows reserved names are not allowed.

replace_invalid.description: Archive/recreation request only: supply name and this flag alone. Requires explicit harness consent before replacement code is prepared. Approval immediately archives the invalid original in INVALID_name; returns without creating. Then use false with a complete definition for separately approved ordinary creation. No rollback; valid and native tools are protected.

input_schema.description: Valid JSON Schema for tool arguments with explicit root type object; define named inputs under properties and required as an array of property names.

files.description: Relative file paths mapped to text contents; may use any language supported by the selected runtime.

command.description: Exec argv array, not shell text: keep executable and each argument separate, e.g. ["python3", "{artifact_dir}/main.py"]. Paths with spaces remain a single entry. The command runs as a subprocess. The harness serializes arguments as JSON on stdin; the program must read them, invoke its logic, and emit the needed result on stdout in the format requested by the task (not necessarily JSON). Defining a handler or returning a value alone neither invokes it nor prints its result; the harness does not invoke handlers automatically. Send diagnostics to stderr. Creation statically validates the definition without executing or proving correctness. Actual execution requires separate approval; compare observed output with the task before claiming completion. Empty stdout is not evidence that expected metrics or other results exist. Runs in the target project; use {artifact_dir} for bundled files and {workspace_dir} for the project. HARNESS_SKILL_DIRS contains allowed skill paths as JSON.
